draft.title: Types of landscape
card: The world has several main types of landscape: mountains, deserts, grasslands, forests, wetlands and coasts.
Climate helps shape each type. Rainfall and temperature affect plants, rivers, and how fast rock wears away.
The rocks beneath also matter. Hard rock may stay as cliffs or peaks, while soft rock wears away more easily.
A desert is dry and has few plants. A wetland is land that is covered with water for part or all of the year.
draft.remember: Climate and rock type help shape each kind of landscape.

a.q: Which landscape type is land covered with water for part or all of the year?
a.why: A wetland is land that is covered with water for some or all of the year. A desert is the opposite, as it is dry with few plants.
a.clue: Think of land that is often under water.

b.q: Two coastlines have the same climate. One has tall cliffs and the other has low, worn-down shores. What best explains the difference?
opts: The type of rock beneath each coast
The climate is different at each coast
One coast is a wetland landscape
One coast has no rock beneath it
b.why: With the same climate, the rock beneath is the factor left to explain the difference. Hard rock can stand as cliffs, while soft rock wears away. Climate cannot explain it here, as it is the same.
b.clue: The question says the climate is the same.

b.best: The type of rock beneath each coast
